name: FillMissingValuesNode
label: Fill Missing Values
description: Fills missing (null) values in a column using a constant, the previous or next value, or the group mean.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table whose missing values will be filled.

fields.name: Column
fields.label: Column
fields.description: The name of the column to fill.

selectOptions.label: Constant
selectOptions.description: Replaces missing values with a constant value.

selectOptions.label: Previous Value
selectOptions.description: Carries forward the last non-null value (forward fill).

selectOptions.label: Next Value
selectOptions.description: Uses the next non-null value (backward fill).

selectOptions.label: Group Mean
selectOptions.description: Replaces missing values with the mean of the values within the group.

fields.name: ConstantValue
fields.label: Constant Value
fields.description: The constant value used by the Constant fill method.

fields.name: GroupByColumns
fields.label: Group By Columns
fields.description: Comma-separated column names used to group rows when computing the group mean. Optional.

fields.name: UpdatedDataTable
fields.label: Updated Data Table
fields.description: The data table with missing values filled.
